description: Store or clear custom properties on a sequence: named text, number or true/false values a script keeps with it, carried into FCP XML exports. One undo step

persistent.description: Save the values with the project (false keeps them for this session only). Default true

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

values.description: Names and the values to store, e.g. { "review.status": "approved" }

name: set_sequence_properties
title: Set Sequence Properties
